title.from: Deploy the lab front end on merge
title.to: Pipeline stage: publish the lab front end to Amplify

description.from: The lab page is a manual Amplify app built from main via amplify.yml. Follow Papyrus: turn auto-build off where needed and start the Amplify job for the exact commit through OIDC with amplify:StartJob and GetJob only, after the backend it needs. Order matters when a front end depends on a new API. Check hosted mode before publishing.
description.to: The lab page is Amplify app cyclotron-console: static, no repository connected, auto-build off, not in any stack. Add a stage after the backend verifies that builds with amplify.yml's commands (npm --prefix trace-ui ci, npm --prefix trace-ui run build, node trace-ui/scripts/package-console.mjs) and publishes the zip of trace-ui/console-dist with amplify create-deployment and start-deployment. Never publish the Lambda's vendored bundle; it is not hosted mode. Connecting a repository to the app is the alternative if this proves awkward. Check sign-in works after the first publish.
